info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Asset Management API
info.description: The Collateral Asset Management API facilitates updates and modifications to collateral asset details within a banking framework. This API is designed for financial institutions aiming to efficiently manage their collateral assets, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements. Common use cases include adjusting asset valuations or terms based on changing market conditions or internal policies. Developers and analysts can leverage this API to maintain up-to-date records and enhance asset utilization strategies.
